question: Does a nested-cross-validated, strongly regularized linear classifier recover the source-aware A1/A2/off gate without memorizing lexical groups?

prior_art.known_lessons: The native-state router is information-impossible; source centroids collapse to off; the gold mixture composes; high-dimensional supervised fitting can memorize 32 training rows unless lexical groups are held out inside model selection.
prior_art.novelty: Optimize the explicit branch-classification target with class-balanced dual ridge and nested leave-one-group-out selection, rather than optimizing an orthogonal complement or raw centroid distance.

frozen_design.features: The same concatenated A1/A2 proposed entry12 semantic-position deltas, centered by training mean and row-L2-normalized.
frozen_design.classifier: Class-balanced least-squares three-class linear ridge in the dual, with an intercept and relative penalties [1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10] times trace(K)/n.
frozen_design.selection: Eight leave-one-group-out folds within the opposite-parity training set. Lexicographically minimize P/C-to-target errors, then maximize macro accuracy, then choose the larger penalty. Refit once on all training groups; held parity is opened once.
frozen_design.causal_program: Use the held prediction to select A1 delta, A2 delta, or zero, project through the fixed opposite-parity construction union, and install at entry12. No held label, logit, answer ID, or behavioral outcome enters fitting or routing.
frozen_design.controls: Report the full nested grid, selected penalty, held confusion, learned/gold/ungated causal programs, full/zero replays, and P/C KL/flips.

predictions.pred_a_authority_nested_scope_replay_geo: Hashes, group-disjoint nested folds, held parity sealing, replays, finite geometry, selected-grid membership, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_regularized_router_identifies_hel: Held macro accuracy is >=.875 in both parities and no P/C row is predicted A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_routed_union_preserves_both_targe: The learned routed program projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 on both targets in both parities.
predictions.pred_d_routed_union_is_control_selective: The program has zero P/C flips and mean KL <=.02 in both parities.
predictions.pred_e_router_retains_ungated_union_effe: Every routed target projection is at least 90% of its corresponding ungated union projection.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E licenses OOD routing and weight translation. A gold pass with B failure rejects regularized linear source routing and sends the route to prospective nonlinear interaction or explicit token-level gates, not a wider penalty grid. B without C rejects causal mixture execution; C without D retains control leakage.
